description: VC-RoE (Vibe Coding · Rules of Engagement) hooks: SessionStart injects the matching slice, writes the heartbeat anchor, and acquires a chat-claim for multi-chat-access protection (added v1.3.0); UserPromptSubmit emits the elapsed-time clock tag per D-MET-33 (informational since v1.20.0, 30-minute cadence); PostToolUse mirrors the clock tag during autonomous-work windows where no user prompt fires (added v1.1.0); Stop greps the assistant transcript for the heartbeat sentinel, advances LAST_HEARTBEAT (layered fail-safe per D-MET-41), and refreshes the chat-claim ts (added v1.3.0); SessionEnd releases the chat-claim (added v1.3.0). Renamed from vc-roe at v1.0.0.
